description: Fresh EN observatory operations admission domain.

units.title: Dome ventilation
units.text: The dome vents are opened before observing so indoor air can approach the outside temperature. Reducing the temperature difference limits local air turbulence around the optical path.

units.title: Instrument rebalance
units.text: After a camera or other heavy instrument is changed, the telescope is rebalanced before normal slewing. The adjustment reduces uneven load on the drive system.

units.title: Flat field exposure
units.text: A flat field exposure records an evenly illuminated reference so later image processing can correct pixel-to-pixel response differences and broad illumination variation.

units.title: Condensation risk
units.text: When the optic temperature approaches the measured dew point, the operator pauses exposed observing and uses the approved dew-control procedure before continuing.

units.title: Focus verification
units.text: Focus is checked again after a meaningful temperature change because mechanical dimensions and the optical train can shift as the equipment cools.

units.title: Night log
units.text: The night log records configuration changes, weather interruptions, calibration actions, and unusual instrument behavior so later data review can reconstruct observing conditions.
